benchmark.category: an AI video production studio for Indonesian creators (AutoClip clipper, AutoMotion footage polish, Explainer generator)
benchmark.users: Indonesian content creators and social media producers turning a YouTube reference, their own footage or a trending topic into scored, reviewed, publishable short videos for Reels, Shorts and TikTok

requirements.source_phrase: Email and Password Login
requirements.statement: The sign-in screen at /sign-in accepts an email and password and, on valid credentials, lands the user on the studio dashboard showing that user's own projects
requirements.notes: Entry point the user chose in the clarifying question; everything else is unreachable without it.

requirements.source_phrase: Email and Password Login
requirements.statement: Sign-in with a registered email and the correct password returns a session token the API accepts, and a wrong password is refused with an error and issues no session
requirements.notes: Identity provider is Clerk per required_credentials; test user kreator+clerk_test@example.com.

requirements.statement: Opening /sign-in?__clerk_ticket=<ticket> with a valid ticket signs the user in and lands on the studio dashboard; an invalid or expired ticket shows an error and leaves the visitor signed out
requirements.notes: Build reveals ticket-based UI sign-in in required_credentials (/app/scripts/clerk_token.py ... ticket).

requirements.statement: A Clerk ticket exchanged at the sign-in callback yields a valid session and a used or expired ticket is refused with no session
requirements.notes: required_credentials describes the ticket flow; a replayed ticket must not mint a second session.

requirements.source_phrase: Utamakan preview video, progres pekerjaan, dan antrean review.
requirements.statement: The studio dashboard renders the signed-in user's video previews with thumbnails, the running job progress, and the review queue on one screen without scrolling past a blocked area
requirements.notes: The brief names these three as the dashboard priority.

requirements.source_phrase: Simpan proyek, aset, versi, dan Brand Kit per pengguna.
requirements.statement: GET /api/projects with a valid token returns only the caller's projects, each with id, title, mode, status, thumbnail URL and best_score
requirements.notes: Dashboard and projects page both read this endpoint.

requirements.source_phrase: Tiga kartu mode memiliki identitas visual berbeda: AutoClip tembaga, AutoMotion violet, Explainer jade.
requirements.statement: The dashboard shows exactly three mode cards - AutoClip in copper, AutoMotion in violet, Explainer in jade - visually distinguishable from each other, and each opens its own new-project flow
requirements.notes: Each card's identity is a named colour, checkable from computed styles.

requirements.statement: POST /api/projects accepts mode values autoclip, automotion and explainer, stores the mode on the project and returns it unchanged on later reads; any other mode value is refused
requirements.notes: Build description lists three modes as the project types.

requirements.statement: Account kreator+clerk_test@example.com owns exactly three completed projects - one autoclip, one automotion, one explainer - each in status review with a thumbnail and a best_score, and account kreator2+clerk_test@example.com owns none of them
requirements.notes: Seed values come from required_credentials and the developer's test list; later phases seed from this.

requirements.statement: /projects lists the signed-in user's projects with title, mode and status and opens the chosen project's review screen on click
requirements.notes: Build description names a Projects page; the archetype needs a project index.

requirements.statement: /projects/{id} renders the review screen with a video player, a version selector, tabs Skor, Revisi, Metadata, Ekspor and Rencana, and an approve control
requirements.notes: Build description lists these review-screen surfaces; the brief requires play, revise and approve in one place.

requirements.source_phrase: Tampilkan progres nyata per tahap yang tetap tersedia setelah refresh.
requirements.statement: GET /api/projects/{id} for the owner returns the stage list, all videos with their versions, and signed media URLs that resolve to playable files
requirements.notes: The refresh-survival promise lives in this response.

requirements.source_phrase: AutoClip — Terima URL YouTube sebagai referensi dan file master dari unggahan atau penyimpanan berizin.
requirements.statement: The AutoClip new-project form accepts a YouTube URL and a master video file upload from the user's device and submits both
requirements.notes: Two input routes in one clause: reference URL and master file.

requirements.source_phrase: AutoClip — Terima URL YouTube sebagai referensi dan file master dari unggahan atau penyimpanan berizin.
requirements.statement: POST /api/projects/{id}/sources stores the YouTube URL and the uploaded master file, and GET /api/projects/{id} returns both with the master's original file name after a reload and from a new session

requirements.source_phrase: Analisis transkrip dan timestamp.
requirements.statement: An AutoClip job analyses the master's transcript and timestamps and stores the transcript segments it used, readable from the project detail response
requirements.notes: When no transcript can be obtained the job must say so rather than produce empty clips (see transcript-be).

requirements.source_phrase: Targetkan 5 klip berbeda, masing-masing dengan hook, konteks, payoff, dan CTA yang sesuai.
requirements.statement: An AutoClip job produces up to five distinct clip records, each carrying a hook, context, payoff and CTA field drawn from the source material, and the clips are playable files
requirements.notes: Five is a target, not a floor; the fewer-clips rule is separate.

requirements.source_phrase: Jika bahan hanya mendukung lebih sedikit klip, jelaskan alasannya.
requirements.statement: When a project yields fewer than five clips, the review screen states, in Indonesian, why the material supported fewer

requirements.source_phrase: Jika bahan hanya mendukung lebih sedikit klip, jelaskan alasannya.
requirements.statement: The project response carries a reason string whenever the produced clip count is below five, and the reason is non-empty for that case

requirements.source_phrase: Tambahkan subtitle sinkron, crop yang mengikuti subjek, B-roll, animasi, musik, serta voice-over bila perlu.
requirements.statement: Every AutoClip clip record references a synced SRT subtitle track, a subject-tracking crop, B-roll footage, an animation layer, a music track and a voice-over audio track in the stored output
requirements.notes: Check by content of the produced artifacts, not response status.

requirements.source_phrase: Urutkan preview berdasarkan kualitas.
requirements.statement: AutoClip previews are listed best-quality first, and the order is the same after a reload

requirements.source_phrase: Urutkan preview berdasarkan kualitas.
requirements.statement: Each clip carries a numeric quality score and GET returns the clips sorted by it descending, so two reads give the same order

requirements.source_phrase: Pengguna mengunggah footage.
requirements.statement: The AutoMotion new-project form accepts a footage upload from the user's device and submits it for processing

requirements.source_phrase: Pengguna mengunggah footage.
requirements.statement: POST stores the uploaded footage for the project and returns it, with original file name and size, from a later read in a new session

requirements.source_phrase: AI merapikan jeda, audio, ritme, dan framing, lalu menambahkan subtitle, tipografi, motion graphics, B-roll, serta ilustrasi sesuai konteks.
requirements.statement: An AutoMotion job produces a final video whose stored metadata records trimmed pauses, normalised audio and rhythm, reframed footage, plus subtitles, typography, motion graphics, B-roll and context-matched illustrations, and the file is non-empty and playable
requirements.notes: Video jobs take 1-4 minutes per the build note; reuse the existing automotion project rather than submitting a new heavy job.

requirements.source_phrase: Hasilkan video final yang dapat diputar dan diunduh.
requirements.statement: The produced AutoMotion video plays inside the review player and downloads as an MP4 file that opens and plays

requirements.source_phrase: Ide Hari Ini
requirements.statement: The Explainer entry screen offers two labelled choices, Ide Hari Ini and Topik Sendiri, and each opens its own form
requirements.notes: Both paths feed the same pipeline; only the inputs differ.

requirements.source_phrase: Untuk Topik Sendiri, cukup satu kalimat dan pilihan gaya.
requirements.statement: The Topik Sendiri form takes one sentence and one visual style, and submits only when both are present
POST /api/projects with mode explainer stores the chosen path; a custom path requires a topic sentence and a style and is refused without them, a trend path requires a selected idea id
requirements.notes: Backs both Explainer entry forms; the refusal is the paranoid half.

requirements.source_phrase: Untuk Ide Hari Ini, cari sinyal tren aktual Indonesia dan global.
requirements.statement: Choosing Ide Hari Ini shows up to five trending ideas for Indonesia and for global audiences, each with its source, region, WIB update time and relevance reason

requirements.source_phrase: Tampilkan hingga 5 ide beserta sumber, wilayah, waktu pembaruan WIB, dan alasan relevansi.
requirements.statement: GET /api/trends returns at most five ideas, each carrying source, region, updated_wib in WIB and a relevance reason, and never returns a sixth idea

requirements.source_phrase: Secara default AI memilih ide terbaik sehingga pengguna cukup memilih gaya visual.
requirements.statement: Exactly one returned trend idea is flagged recommended, and creating an Explainer from Ide Hari Ini without picking an idea uses that recommended idea so the user only has to choose a style

requirements.source_phrase: Jika data tren tidak tersedia, beri label evergreen.
requirements.statement: When no trend data is available the Ide Hari Ini screen labels the ideas as evergreen rather than showing an empty list or an error

requirements.source_phrase: Jika data tren tidak tersedia, beri label evergreen.
requirements.statement: GET /api/trends with the trend provider unavailable returns ideas marked evergreen instead of an error or an empty array

requirements.source_phrase: Kedua jalur otomatis menghasilkan riset, narasi, storyboard per adegan, visual, voice-over, subtitle, musik, dan video.
requirements.statement: Both Explainer paths produce and store research text, a narration script, a per-scene storyboard, scene visuals, voice-over audio, subtitles, a music track and a final playable video for the project

requirements.source_phrase: Sediakan gaya clay, 2D, 3D, dan realistis sesuai kemampuan provider.
requirements.statement: The Explainer form offers exactly the styles clay, 2D, 3D and realistis, and the chosen style is sent with the request
requirements.notes: 'sesuai kemampuan provider' is unspecified, so all four stay offered; see unmapped_phrases.

requirements.source_phrase: Gambar AI per adegan yang dianimasikan
requirements.statement: Each storyboard scene gets an AI image generated for that scene and the image is animated into the final video, so the number of stored scene images equals the number of scenes and every image file is non-empty
requirements.notes: User's chosen answer on how scene visuals are made.

requirements.source_phrase: Jaga konsistensi karakter, palet, dan suara antaradegan.
requirements.statement: Character description, colour palette and voice selection are stored once per project and reused for every generated scene, so all scenes share the same character, palette and voice

requirements.source_phrase: GPT
requirements.statement: Research, narration script, editorial score and per-platform captions are produced by the GPT model from the project's own topic and source material, and contain at least one entity from that material rather than a generic template
requirements.notes: User's chosen answer for which AI writes research, script, editorial score and captions.

requirements.source_phrase: Hangat dan tenang; Dalam dan sinematik
requirements.statement: The default narration voice is a warm and calm voice, a deep and cinematic voice is selectable, and the chosen voice is stored per project and used in the produced voice-over
requirements.notes: User's answer to the default voice-over question; two descriptors imply a default plus an alternative.

requirements.source_phrase: Simpan proyek, aset, versi, dan Brand Kit per pengguna.
requirements.statement: Projects, assets, versions and the Brand Kit are stored against the owning user and every read returns only that user's rows

requirements.source_phrase: Simpan proyek, aset, versi, dan Brand Kit per pengguna.
requirements.statement: The Brand Kit screen loads the signed-in user's saved palette, fonts and logo, saves edits, and shows the saved values again after a reload

requirements.source_phrase: Simpan proyek, aset, versi, dan Brand Kit per pengguna.
requirements.statement: GET /api/brand-kit returns the caller's Brand Kit and PUT /api/brand-kit stores palette, font and logo so a later GET from a new session returns the saved values
requirements.notes: Two users must hold independent Brand Kits.

requirements.source_phrase: Tampilkan progres nyata per tahap yang tetap tersedia setelah refresh.
requirements.statement: A project's stage list shows each stage as pending, running or done, advances while a job runs, and shows the same states after a page refresh
requirements.notes: The user's core anti-fake-progress promise.

requirements.source_phrase: Tampilkan progres nyata per tahap yang tetap tersedia setelah refresh.
requirements.statement: GET /api/projects/{id} returns every stage with its state and a percentage, the values come from the job's real state, and they never regress from done to pending on a later read

requirements.source_phrase: Beri setiap video skor editorial 0–100, alasan, serta saran perbaikan dengan timestamp.
requirements.statement: The Skor tab shows the selected video's editorial score as a whole number from 0 to 100, its written reasons, and improvement suggestions each carrying a timestamp

requirements.source_phrase: Beri setiap video skor editorial 0–100, alasan, serta saran perbaikan dengan timestamp.
requirements.statement: Every video record carries an integer editorial score within 0-100 inclusive, written reasons, and suggestions that each hold a timestamp inside the video's duration

requirements.source_phrase: Buat judul, caption, dan hashtag per platform.
requirements.statement: The Metadata tab shows a title, caption and hashtag set for each of Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, YouTube/Shorts and TikTok

requirements.source_phrase: Buat judul, caption, dan hashtag per platform.
requirements.statement: The project response returns exactly one title, one caption and one hashtag list per platform for the four named platforms, each non-empty for a completed video

requirements.source_phrase: Di layar review, pengguna bisa memutar hasil, merevisi bagian tertentu, lalu menyetujui versi final.
requirements.statement: On the review screen the user can play the selected version's video in the player and watch it to the end
requirements.notes: First of three behaviours in the sentence; revise and approve are separate requirements.

requirements.statement: The MP4 media endpoint returns 200 with the file for a plain GET and 206 for a Range request, and the same URL with download=1 returns Content-Disposition attachment with the video's file name
requirements.notes: Build note: playable-and-downloadable MP4 is the production test the user asked for.

requirements.source_phrase: Di layar review, pengguna bisa memutar hasil, merevisi bagian tertentu, lalu menyetujui versi final.
requirements.statement: Choosing Revisi on a version queues a revision, the screen shows the video as revising, and when the revision finishes a new version appears in the version list while the previous version is still playable
requirements.notes: Revision jobs cost AI credits per the build note; check the already-queued explainer revision rather than spamming new ones.

requirements.source_phrase: Di layar review, pengguna bisa memutar hasil, merevisi bagian tertentu, lalu menyetujui versi final.
requirements.statement: POST /api/videos/{id}/revise queues one job, sets the video status to revising, and on completion stores a new version numbered after the last one with the earlier versions still retrievable

requirements.source_phrase: Di layar review, pengguna bisa memutar hasil, merevisi bagian tertentu, lalu menyetujui versi final.
requirements.statement: Pressing approve marks the shown version as approved and the control visibly changes to the approved state, offering undo

requirements.source_phrase: Di layar review, pengguna bisa memutar hasil, merevisi bagian tertentu, lalu menyetujui versi final.
requirements.statement: POST approve marks exactly the chosen version approved for that user, GET returns it approved after a reload, and unapprove returns it to review status without touching other versions

requirements.source_phrase: Dukung ekspor MP4, subtitle SRT, dan metadata.
requirements.statement: The Ekspor tab offers MP4 download, SRT subtitle download and metadata JSON download, and each downloaded file opens as its type under a file name that says which project and version it is

requirements.source_phrase: Dukung ekspor MP4, subtitle SRT, dan metadata.
requirements.statement: The export endpoints return the MP4 as video/mp4, the SRT as a text file with sequential numbered cues, and the metadata as JSON holding the project's title, per-platform caption and hashtags, each with a Content-Disposition file name

requirements.source_phrase: Integrasikan Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, YouTube/Shorts, dan TikTok melalui OAuth resmi.
requirements.statement: The Publikasi page lists Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, YouTube/Shorts and TikTok as connectable channels and offers a connect action on each

requirements.source_phrase: Jika izin atau kredensial belum tersedia, tampilkan kebutuhan konfigurasi dan pertahankan ekspor manual.
requirements.statement: GET /api/channels returns exactly the four channels Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, YouTube/Shorts and TikTok, each with configured=false and the required_env names while no platform credentials exist, and POST connect for such a channel returns 412 naming the missing configuration without creating a connection
requirements.notes: Build note: social publishing has no credentials by design, so configuration-needed is the expected outcome, not a bug.

requirements.source_phrase: Kirim atau jadwalkan hanya setelah pengguna menyetujui versi, akun, visibilitas, dan waktu tayang.
requirements.statement: The publish dialog refuses to confirm until the user has chosen an approved version, an account, a visibility and a publish time, and it shows the channel's missing configuration instead of a publish action when the channel is not connected

requirements.source_phrase: Kirim atau jadwalkan hanya setelah pengguna menyetujui versi, akun, visibilitas, dan waktu tayang.
requirements.statement: POST /api/publications with an unapproved version returns 400 and stores no publication; with an approved version but an unconnected channel it returns 412 and stores no publication; with all four confirmations present it stores the publication
requirements.notes: The approval gate is the rule the user called out; it must hold on the API, not only in the dialog.

requirements.source_phrase: Lacak status per kanal dan cegah unggahan ganda.
requirements.statement: The Publikasi page shows for each publication its per-channel status, and a failed or blocked channel shows the reason rather than a success

requirements.source_phrase: Lacak status per kanal dan cegah unggahan ganda.
requirements.statement: GET /api/publications returns each publication with one status per target channel, and the status of a channel that never uploaded is a failed or blocked state with its reason, never published

requirements.source_phrase: Simpan token dan API key di server.
requirements.statement: Platform tokens and AI provider API keys are read from server-side configuration and never appear in any API response, page source or client bundle

requirements.source_phrase: Tandai simulasi secara eksplisit.
requirements.statement: Any artifact the app simulated - procedural music, placeholder imagery, a canned sample - is visibly labelled as a simulation on the screen that shows it

requirements.source_phrase: Tandai simulasi secara eksplisit.
requirements.statement: Each produced artifact records whether it was simulated and the project API returns that flag so the screen can label it
requirements.notes: Build note says background music is procedurally generated ffmpeg ambience, which must be marked.

requirements.source_phrase: Publikasikan aplikasi, uji produksi satu video sampai MP4 dapat diputar dan diunduh, lalu laporkan URL, mode yang berhasil diuji, serta integrasi yang masih memerlukan API key atau persetujuan platform.
requirements.statement: The deployed app at a reachable URL completes one production run to an MP4 that plays and downloads, and the report names the URL, the modes tested and the integrations still needing an API key or platform approval
requirements.notes: Deliverable check: the report is a required artifact of the work, not just the app.

requirements.statement: Signing in with a wrong password shows an error message on the sign-in screen and leaves the visitor signed out rather than navigating to the studio
requirements.notes: Paranoid half of the sign-in promise.

requirements.statement: Signing out from the studio returns the user to the sign-in screen, and navigating back to a studio URL afterwards makes no signed-in request and shows no project data
requirements.notes: Session-exists row of the paranoid table.

requirements.statement: After sign-out the previous session token is refused with 401 by project, video, brand-kit and publication endpoints
Reloading any signed-in page keeps the session and lands the user on the same screen with the same data
A session token that is expired or invalid is refused with 401 on every API call, and the screen that receives it routes the user to sign-in instead of rendering blank

requirements.source_phrase: Simpan proyek, aset, versi, dan Brand Kit per pengguna.
requirements.statement: A signed-in user requesting GET /api/projects/{id} for another user's project receives 404 and no field of that project, and the same refusal holds for its videos, versions and exports
requirements.notes: Direct-link and guessed-id refusal for the per-user boundary the brief sets.

requirements.statement: Signing in as kreator2+clerk_test@example.com shows none of kreator+clerk_test@example.com's projects on the dashboard or /projects, and opening one of that user's project URLs shows a not-found state
requirements.notes: Second account named in required_credentials exists for exactly this check.

requirements.statement: Every project listing, search, count and aggregate endpoint returns only rows owned by the caller, so user B's totals never include user A's projects
A freshly created account with no projects sees an explicit empty state with a create-project action on the dashboard and /projects, not a blank area or a spinner that never ends
requirements.notes: List-shown row of the paranoid table: zero rows.

requirements.statement: GET /api/projects for a user with no projects returns 200 with an empty list, not an error and not another user's rows
With a hundred projects stored, GET /api/projects pages the results so every project appears exactly once across the pages and the total it reports equals the number of rows returned
requirements.notes: List-shown row of the paranoid table: a thousand rows.

requirements.statement: Approving an already approved version twice leaves one approved state and one record, and approving one version does not approve its siblings
requirements.notes: Paranoid half of the approve action.

requirements.statement: POST /api/videos/{id}/revise for another user's video or an unknown video id is refused with 404 and queues no job
requirements.notes: Guessed-id refusal on the costliest endpoint.

requirements.statement: PUT /api/brand-kit with a malformed colour value or an unsupported font is refused with a validation error and the stored Brand Kit is unchanged
requirements.notes: Build list mentions Brand Kit validation.

requirements.statement: The downloaded SRT holds the same subtitle lines as the exported version with cue numbers starting at 1 and strictly increasing timestamps, and the MP4 it belongs to is the same version
requirements.notes: Value-displayed-equals-stored row applied to the subtitle file.

requirements.statement: When a thumbnail or media URL is broken the review screen shows a placeholder and an error message instead of a blank player or a silent failure

requirements.source_phrase: Lacak status per kanal dan cegah unggahan ganda.
requirements.statement: Two publish requests for the same video version and channel, including two arriving together, create one publication and produce one upload
requirements.notes: Duplicate-upload prevention is explicitly required.

requirements.source_phrase: Kirim atau jadwalkan hanya setelah pengguna menyetujui versi, akun, visibilitas, dan waktu tayang.
requirements.statement: A publication scheduled for a time in the past is refused and nothing is queued, while a future time is stored and the channel status stays scheduled until that time
requirements.notes: Past-date row of the paranoid table applied to the scheduled publish time.

requirements.statement: Submitting an Explainer Topik Sendiri form with an empty sentence or with no style chosen is refused with a message on the form and creates no project
GET /api/projects/{unknown-id} returns 404 with no project fields, and the SPA route for that id renders a not-found state rather than crashing or a blank page
requirements.notes: Deep-link row of the paranoid table.

requirements.statement: Every stored editorial score is an integer from 0 to 100 inclusive, the project best_score equals the highest score among its versions, and no endpoint returns a score outside that range
requirements.notes: Business-logic class: the aggregate must equal its parts.

requirements.statement: A project's progress percentage equals the number of done stages divided by the total stages, rounded consistently, and a stage once done stays done
requirements.notes: Progress is shown in several places and must agree everywhere.

requirements.statement: A video's versions are numbered consecutively from v1 with no gaps or duplicates, and every produced revision takes the next number

A video moves only through its allowed statuses - queued, running, review, revising, approved - a revision on an approved video returns it to revising, and a refused transition leaves the stored status unchanged
requirements.notes: Domain state transitions the review screen depends on.

requirements.source_phrase: Tampilkan hingga 5 ide beserta sumber, wilayah, waktu pembaruan WIB, dan alasan relevansi.
requirements.statement: Trend update times and publication schedule times are stored with a time zone and rendered in WIB (UTC+7), with the same instant shown on the trends screen and in the metadata export
requirements.notes: The user named WIB explicitly; the rule holds wherever the time appears.

requirements.source_phrase: Beri setiap video skor editorial 0–100, alasan, serta saran perbaikan dengan timestamp.
requirements.statement: Every improvement suggestion's timestamp is at or after 0 and at or before the video's duration, and clicking it seeks the player to that position
requirements.notes: A timestamp outside the media is the classic wrong-timestamp defect.

requirements.source_phrase: Gunakan latar hitam plum, aksen champagne, judul serif elegan, serta objek 3D dengan animasi halus yang menghormati reduced motion.
requirements.statement: Studio, review, projects, brand kit and publikasi screens all render on the plum-black background with champagne accents and serif headings, body text meets at least 4.5:1 contrast against its background, and the smooth 3D object appears on the dashboard
requirements.notes: Contrast ratio is named so two engineers check it the same way.

requirements.statement: The studio page serves every asset it references - CSS bundle, 3D model or its fallback - with 200, and no referenced asset returns 404
requirements.notes: Backs the theme, language and reduced-motion checks: a missing asset or unbuilt bundle breaks them all.

requirements.source_phrase: Gunakan latar hitam plum, aksen champagne, judul serif elegan, serta objek 3D dengan animasi halus yang menghormati reduced motion.
requirements.statement: With prefers-reduced-motion set, the 3D object and card animations stop or reduce to no motion while all content stays visible and usable

requirements.source_phrase: Buat dashboard studio sinematik yang responsif.
requirements.statement: At a 390px viewport the studio dashboard and the review screen render without horizontal scrolling, overlapping text or clipped video, and the play and approve controls are reachable
requirements.notes: Mobile is in the task list of surfaces to test.

requirements.source_phrase: aplikasi web AI berbahasa Indonesia untuk kreator konten
requirements.statement: All user-facing copy across the studio screens is in Bahasa Indonesia and the product names itself Luma Atelier
Every save the user performs - Brand Kit, project settings, a publication schedule - shows a visible confirmation on success and, on failure, a message in Indonesian naming what went wrong
requirements.notes: Nothing succeeds silently and nothing fails silently.

requirements.statement: Submitting a video job shows stage progress that advances and reaches a finished state, and a failed job shows its error instead of stalling on the last stage
requirements.notes: Long-operation feedback; jobs take 1-4 minutes per the build note.

requirements.statement: Each of the Skor, Revisi, Metadata, Ekspor and Rencana tabs on the review screen renders its own content for the selected video and none renders a blank panel
requirements.notes: Tabs named in the build description of the review screen.

requirements.statement: The URL of a review screen names the project and the selected version, and reloading it lands on the same project and version with their data
Opening a project review URL directly while signed in renders that project, and opening an unknown project id renders a not-found message inside the app shell rather than a crash or blank page
Loading, disabled, approved and error states of the review screen look different from each other, and the approve control stays disabled while a revision is running
Submitting one Explainer Topik Sendiri job from the wizard moves the user to the project with stage progress that still shows the same states after a page refresh
requirements.notes: Task list allows at most one new heavy job to verify progress persistence; reuse existing projects otherwise.

requirements.statement: The review player plays, pauses, seeks and shows elapsed and total duration of the selected version
requirements.notes: benchmark: every video review tool gives play, pause, scrub and duration; the review screen is judged on it.

requirements.statement: Selecting a different version in the review screen loads that version's video and its score and metadata, and the selected version is visibly indicated
requirements.notes: benchmark: video tools let the user compare versions before approving one.

requirements.statement: Opening any studio URL while signed out redirects to the sign-in screen and shows none of the stored project data
Every project, video, media, brand-kit, channel and publication endpoint returns 401 without a valid token and returns the caller's data with one
requirements.notes: Checked directly from the test list: 401 without token, 200 with token.

requirements.statement: A new visitor can create an account with an email and password, verify the email, and lands in an empty studio of their own
requirements.notes: Product shell: password login implies account creation.

requirements.statement: Sign-up with an already registered email is refused and creates no second account, and a password below the provider's minimum length is refused with a message
The sign-in screen offers a password recovery link that accepts an email and reports that a reset message was sent without revealing whether the account exists
requirements.notes: Product shell: password accounts need recovery.

requirements.statement: A password reset link sent to kreator+clerk_test@example.com sets a new password once; afterwards the new password signs in and the old one is refused
Every project, asset, version and export a user creates is readable after a reload and from a new session, and a failed create leaves no partial project or orphan file
requirements.notes: Data/persistence class: whole success or whole failure.

requirements.statement: Deleting a project from the projects list asks for confirmation, removes the project from the list, and its review screen URL then shows not-found
requirements.notes: Archetype baseline: any project list gives the owner a delete.

requirements.statement: DELETE /api/projects/{id} removes the project, its videos, versions and exports for the owner and leaves no media URL of it returning 200, while another user's identical request is refused
The score, status, duration and version count shown on a project card and review screen equal the values the API returns for that video, with no empty or another project's value
requirements.notes: Value-displayed row of the paranoid table.

requirements.statement: Every field the new-project forms send - mode, topic sentence, style, YouTube URL, visibility, schedule time - is stored and returned by the project read endpoint unchanged

A master or footage upload of a non-video type or above the configured size limit is refused with a message naming the limit, and an accepted upload is stored and listed with its original file name and byte size
requirements.notes: File class: type and size limits must be enforced, not just shown.

requirements.source_phrase: Kerjakan frontend, backend, database, penyimpanan media, dan worker video sampai alur input → produksi → review → ekspor MP4 bisa diuji.
requirements.statement: Uploaded masters and produced MP4s are stored outside the process and remain fetchable by their URL after a backend restart
requirements.notes: The brief names media storage and a video worker as deliverables.

requirements.statement: The background music track attached to a video is a non-empty audio file of plausible duration and, being procedurally generated ambience, is flagged as simulated rather than presented as a licensed track
requirements.notes: Build note: background music is procedurally generated with ffmpeg, not licensed tracks.

requirements.statement: When the AI, image, speech or video provider key is missing or the provider errors or times out, the job fails with an error message the user can read naming the step, and never stores a placeholder video, an empty script, a canned caption or the same output for every input
requirements.notes: AI class: no empty string, no apology text, no fixed placeholder.

requirements.statement: For a known custom topic, the produced narration, captions and hashtags mention that topic or its named entities and contain nothing from another project's topic, and re-running with a different topic changes the output
requirements.notes: AI class: output content right for its input, checked on a known answer.

requirements.source_phrase: Gambar AI per adegan yang dianimasikan
requirements.statement: Every stored scene image is a non-empty image file that decodes at a plausible resolution, and the count of scene images equals the count of storyboard scenes
requirements.notes: Generated-media class applied to scene images.

requirements.source_phrase: Beri setiap video skor editorial 0–100, alasan, serta saran perbaikan dengan timestamp.
requirements.statement: The editorial score reasons and suggestions refer to elements actually present in the scored video - its topic, hook or a timestamped moment - and differ between two different videos
requirements.notes: AI class: no generic template masquerading as analysis.

requirements.source_phrase: Jika izin atau kredensial belum tersedia, tampilkan kebutuhan konfigurasi dan pertahankan ekspor manual.
requirements.statement: Every external provider - identity, GPT, image, speech, trends, transcription, social platforms - is called with a key read from server-side environment configuration, and a missing key produces an explicit configuration-needed state on screen rather than a fake success
requirements.notes: Integration class; also covers the manual-export fallback staying usable.

requirements.source_phrase: Integrasikan Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, YouTube/Shorts, dan TikTok melalui OAuth resmi.
requirements.statement: A social platform connect flow returns through its registered callback, rejects a mismatched state value, stores the token server-side, and shows a provider refusal or denied scope as an error that leaves the channel unconnected
requirements.notes: Integration class; without platform keys the expected behaviour is configuration-needed, so this check runs on the callback contract.

requirements.source_phrase: Lacak status per kanal dan cegah unggahan ganda.
requirements.statement: When a channel is configured with real test credentials, the upload request reaches that platform with the approved version, account and visibility, the stored per-channel status reflects the platform's actual answer, and a platform error is stored as failed with its reason instead of a fake published
requirements.notes: Integration class; build note says no platform credentials exist, so this remains configuration-needed until keys are supplied.

requirements.source_phrase: Analisis transkrip dan timestamp.
requirements.statement: When the transcript or timestamps of a YouTube reference cannot be obtained, the AutoClip job reports that reason to the user and stores no clips, rather than producing clips from nothing
requirements.notes: Integration class failure path for the transcription provider.

requirements.statement: A project's progress view stops polling when the user leaves the screen, so no further progress requests are made after navigation, and each progress update is applied once
requirements.notes: Performance class: polling must stop on leave and deliver each update once.

requirements.statement: Advances in a running job are delivered to the record once, and repeated reads of a live project's stages never show progress going backwards or a stage counted twice
With a hundred projects stored, the first page of GET /api/projects returns within about two seconds and the projects list renders without loading every row at once
requirements.notes: Performance class: large collections load by page.

requirements.source_phrase: Buat dashboard studio sinematik yang responsif.
requirements.statement: Every route reachable from the navigation - sign-in, studio dashboard, projects, project review, brand kit, publikasi and the three new-project wizards - loads with content and no build error, undefined component or white screen
requirements.notes: Build/deployment class across the screens the build description lists.

requirements.source_phrase: Gunakan stack yang didukung lingkungan deployment.
requirements.statement: The API base URL and media host come from environment configuration with no host written into the built code, and the deployed app behaves as the preview does
The dashboard shows a gallery of the user's produced videos with thumbnail, mode, editorial score and completion date, and clicking one opens its review screen
requirements.notes: benchmark: video studios give a gallery of finished videos; the build description names a gallery.

requirements.statement: When nothing awaits review the dashboard review queue shows an explicit empty message and a link to start a project, not an empty box
requirements.notes: benchmark: review queues in creative tools show a zero state with the next action.

requirements.statement: A search field on /projects filters by project title and by mode, shows the matching projects only, and clearing it restores the full list
requirements.notes: benchmark: any project list in this category is searchable once a creator has more than a handful.

requirements.statement: GET /api/projects?q= filters the caller's projects by title and mode, returns only matching rows from that user, and an empty query returns all of them
requirements.notes: benchmark: project search in content tools filters the owner's own library.

requirements.statement: Each per-platform caption has a copy control that copies exactly that caption and hashtags to the clipboard and confirms the copy
requirements.notes: benchmark: creators paste generated captions into the platform apps, so the copy control is table stakes.

requirements.statement: The saved Brand Kit palette and font are applied to the typography and captions of newly produced videos, so two users with different Brand Kits get visibly different styling
requirements.notes: benchmark: a Brand Kit exists in this product category to make output look consistent, so it must reach the output.

requirements.statement: The render step reads the project owner's Brand Kit colours and font and records them with the produced video, and changing the Brand Kit changes the next produced video's styling
requirements.notes: benchmark: brand kits carry into generated output in creator tools.

unmapped_phrases.phrase: Gunakan prototipe ini sebagai referensi visual jika dapat diakses: https://luma-atelier-studio-ucj.amberpenny1.chatgpt.site
unmapped_phrases.reason: the prototype may be unreachable and a visual reference carries no objective specification beyond the design requirements already written from the brief
which visual capabilities each provider actually supports is not specified, so the style requirement keeps all four styles available and leaves provider support to the configuration-needed state
instruction to the developer agent, not a product requirement
